articles.title: Mandi Inspector Assaulted in Shamli: Traders Accused of Beating, Threatening Official During Fee
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shamli (Uttar Pradesh): A case of alleged assault and misconduct against a market inspector has come to light at the Agricultural Produce Market Committee (Gur Mandi) in Kandhla town under Kandhla police station limits.

body.html:
Shamli (Uttar Pradesh): A case of alleged assault and misconduct against a market inspector has come to light at the Agricultural Produce Market Committee (Gur Mandi) in Kandhla town under Kandhla police station limits.

The incident reportedly took place in the morning when Mandi Inspector Arvind Kumar Yadav was collecting fees from traders as per targets set by the Saharanpur Mandi Parishad.

According to the complaint, when the inspector reached a trader’s shop, a dispute broke out after he was accused of overcharging. It is alleged that four individuals—Shahnawaz Raj, Sabir Raj, Wahid Raj, and Mohid Raj—abused, pushed, and assaulted him.

The inspector further alleged that the accused forcibly took him to an office, where he was harassed and threatened. He was reportedly rescued only after other traders intervened.

In his complaint, Arvind Kumar Yadav stated that the accused also raised slogans against him, issued death threats, and made objectionable religious remarks, warning him not to continue his duties in the market. He also claimed that the accused have a history of intimidating mandi officials and irregularities in payment related to contracts.

A video of the incident has surfaced on social media, showing a heated altercation and alleged manhandling of the official.

The inspector has sought strict legal action and security, stating that his life is in danger. Police said a case has been registered and an investigation is underway. Officials added that action will be taken based on evidence, including the viral video.

#Shamli #Kandhla #MandiNews #AssaultCase #UPPolice

articles.title: YouTuber or Killer? 31-Year-Old Child Murder Case Cracks Open as ‘Salim Vastik’ Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi/Ghaziabad: In a dramatic breakthrough, Delhi Police have arrested a man living under a false identity for over two decades, revealing his alleged involvement in the 1995 kidnapping and murder of a 13-year-old boy in Delhi.

body.html:
New Delhi/Ghaziabad: In a dramatic breakthrough, Delhi Police have arrested a man living under a false identity for over two decades, revealing his alleged involvement in the 1995 kidnapping and murder of a 13-year-old boy in Delhi.

The accused, known in recent years as Salim Vastik, was identified as Salim Khan, a martial arts trainer who was convicted in the murder of Sandeep Bansal, son of a cement trader from Daryaganj.

According to police records, on January 20, 1995, Sandeep left for school but did not return home. The next day, his family received a ransom call demanding ₹30,000, instructing them to leave the money on a bus route near Loni Flyover. However, investigations later revealed that the child had already been killed.

Police found that Sandeep was last seen with Salim Khan. During interrogation, Salim allegedly led police to the boy’s body, which was recovered from a drain in Mustafabad.

In 1997, a Karkardooma court sentenced Salim Khan and his associate Anil to life imprisonment. However, in November 2000, Salim was granted interim bail and subsequently absconded.

During his years on the run, he reportedly lived under different identities in Haryana before settling in Ghaziabad around 2010, where he adopted the name Salim Vastik. He opened a readymade garments shop and later gained attention as a YouTuber and self-styled social activist.

Police said the breakthrough came after fresh inputs led the Crime Branch to suspect his real identity. Fingerprints and old records were matched, confirming that Salim Vastik and Salim Khan were the same person. He was arrested during a raid in Loni and has now been sent to Tihar Jail.

In a separate development earlier this year, the accused had survived a violent attack in Ghaziabad, during which two attackers were killed in police encounters. At the time, he was treated as a victim, but investigations later exposed his alleged criminal past.

Police said further legal proceedings are underway in the decades-old case.

#DelhiPolice #Ghaziabad #MurderCase #Kidnapping #CrimeNews

articles.title: High Court Officer Alleges Manhandling at Bageshwar Baba Event in Prayagraj, Security Under Fire
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh): A controversy erupted during the three-day ‘Rashtra Hanuman Katha’ event led by Pandit Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, after a woman alleged that she was manhandled by security personnel while trying to enter the pandal.

body.html:
Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh): A controversy erupted during the three-day ‘Rashtra Hanuman Katha’ event led by Pandit Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, after a woman alleged that she was manhandled by security personnel while trying to enter the pandal.

The incident occurred on the final day of the event, which witnessed the presence of hundreds of thousands of devotees. According to the woman, she was stopped at the entry gate by bouncers despite requesting permission to enter.

She alleged that the security staff pushed her away and dragged her by the arm, causing scratches on her hands and back. “I sustained injuries due to the behaviour of the bouncers,” she said.

The woman further claimed that she is a review officer in the High Court and warned of legal action against those involved. She had reportedly come to attend the Katha and present a petition at Bageshwar Baba’s court.

Following the commotion, police reached the spot and brought the situation under control.

The incident has raised questions over crowd management and security arrangements at large religious gatherings. No official statement from the event organisers or police regarding action against the security personnel has been issued so far.

#Prayagraj #BageshwarDham #DhirendraShastri #Controversy #BreakingNews

articles.title: Hidden Death Trap on Road: Biker Falls into Water-Filled Pothole in Baghpat, CCTV Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Baghpat (Uttar Pradesh): A shocking incident highlighting civic negligence has come to light from Baghpat, where a biker met with an accident after falling into a deep pothole hidden under waterlogging.

body.html:
Baghpat (Uttar Pradesh): A shocking incident highlighting civic negligence has come to light from Baghpat, where a biker met with an accident after falling into a deep pothole hidden under waterlogging. The entire incident was captured on CCTV and the video is now going viral on social media.

The accident reportedly occurred near a police station in the old town area. CCTV footage shows a heavily waterlogged road, with one side completely submerged, making it impossible to assess the road condition.

In the video, a tractor-trolley is seen passing through the flooded stretch, while a helmeted biker approaches from the opposite direction. As he enters the waterlogged patch, the front wheel of his bike suddenly drops into a deep pothole concealed beneath the water. The rider loses balance and is thrown onto the road.

Locals immediately rushed to the spot and helped the injured biker. Fortunately, he escaped with minor injuries, avoiding a major tragedy.

Residents have expressed strong anger over the condition of the road, alleging that the pothole had been left unattended for a long time without any warning signs or barricades. They said the combination of waterlogging and poor road maintenance has turned the stretch into a serious hazard.

The incident has once again raised questions over civic negligence, with locals demanding immediate repair of the road to prevent further accidents.

#Baghpat #RoadAccident #PotholeCrisis #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews

articles.title: Caught in His Own Trap: Thief Gets Stuck in Iron Grill While Attempting Break-In in Ghaziabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh): In a bizarre incident, a thief got trapped in an iron grill while attempting to break into a locked house in the Shalimar Garden police station area, with a video of the incident now circulating on social media.

body.html:
Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh): In a bizarre incident, a thief got trapped in an iron grill while attempting to break into a locked house in the Shalimar Garden police station area, with a video of the incident now circulating on social media.

According to police, the family had locked their house and stepped out when the youth allegedly attempted to enter the premises. However, due to movement of people in the street, he panicked and tried to escape without committing the theft.

While attempting to flee, the accused got stuck in a narrow gap between the iron grill and the wall, leaving him unable to move. A crowd soon gathered at the spot after noticing him trapped.

Police were informed and reached the scene, following which the youth was safely rescued and taken to the police station. Officials said the boy was reportedly in an intoxicated state at the time of the incident.

Since no theft had taken place and the house owner did not file a complaint, police conducted a medical examination of the youth and later released him with a strict warning.

The unusual incident has sparked discussion in the locality, with many terming it a case of “instant karma,” as the accused got caught in an unexpected situation while attempting the theft.

#Ghaziabad #TheftAttempt #ViralVideo #BizarreNews #UPPolice

articles.title: 11-Year-Old Beaten to Death in Lucknow Gurukul: Operator, Aide Arrested After CCTV Destroyed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow/Kanpur (Uttar Pradesh): In a disturbing case, an 11-year-old boy was allegedly tortured to death at a gurukul in Lucknow, with his body later dumped near his home in Kanpur.

body.html:
Lucknow/Kanpur (Uttar Pradesh): In a disturbing case, an 11-year-old boy was allegedly tortured to death at a gurukul in Lucknow, with his body later dumped near his home in Kanpur. Police have arrested the gurukul operator Saurabh Mishra and his associate Harshita Soni in connection with the case.

The victim, Divyansh Dwivedi, had been admitted to the Ramanuj Bhagwat Ved Vidyapeeth Gurukul on April 15 for Vedic education. Just seven days later, on April 22, his family was informed of his death.

According to police, the accused has confessed that the child was brutally assaulted for not following the gurukul’s rules. He was allegedly beaten with hands, kicks, belts, and sticks. During the assault, his head was slammed against a wall, leading to fatal injuries.
Investigators said that after the incident, Saurabh Mishra called his associate Harshita Soni and allegedly got CCTV cameras at the gurukul smashed in an attempt to destroy evidence.

The child’s family has raised serious allegations, claiming that when the body reached their home, it bore multiple injury marks. They alleged there were around 40–45 injury marks, suggesting severe and prolonged physical abuse. The family also claimed that the child’s hands and legs had been tied.

Initially, the gurukul operator had informed the family that the boy died after falling from the stairs. However, instead of taking him to a hospital, the accused allegedly transported the body by car and abandoned it near the family’s residence in Kanpur before fleeing.

Based on a complaint filed by the victim’s father, Narendra Kumar Dwivedi, police registered an FIR under charges of murder and destruction of evidence.

Additional DCP (East) Anjali Vishwakarma said that a special investigation team has been formed. The team will visit the gurukul premises in Lucknow to collect evidence. A post-mortem examination of the body will be conducted by a panel of doctors with videography to ensure transparency.

Police said further investigation is underway to establish the full sequence of events and identify any additional involvement in the case.

#Lucknow #Kanpur #ChildAbuse #MurderCase #BreakingNews

articles.title: Mob Justice: Man Tonsured, Beaten, Paraded with Wife in Chhattisgarh Village Over Theft Suspicion
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Surajpur (Chhattisgarh): In a shocking case of alleged mob justice, a 32-year-old man was subjected to brutal humiliation and assault by villagers in Pasta village under Ramanujanagar police station limits on suspicion of theft.

body.html:
Surajpur (Chhattisgarh): In a shocking case of alleged mob justice, a 32-year-old man was subjected to brutal humiliation and assault by villagers in Pasta village under Ramanujanagar police station limits on suspicion of theft. A video of the incident has also surfaced and is circulating on social media.

The victim, identified as Mohammad Rehman Taj, a resident of Kalyanpur, was accused by villagers of stealing wires from a solar panel system. According to reports, he was called to the village by the sarpanch’s husband and others for a supposed settlement through a Panchayat.

However, when Rehman arrived along with his wife, villagers allegedly caught him, shaved half his head, placed a garland of shoes and slippers around his neck, and beat him. He was then paraded through the village in a public display of humiliation.

The victim’s wife also alleged serious abuse. She claimed that she was assaulted, humiliated, and threatened with death during the incident. According to her statement, both of them were attacked when they reached the Panchayat after being called.

Rehman’s father has filed a complaint at Ramanujanagar police station, alleging that his son was punished inhumanely based on false accusations.

Police said preliminary findings suggest the man was suspected of attempting theft earlier and had returned to the village the next day, after which the incident occurred. However, officials emphasised that the matter is under investigation.

The sarpanch’s husband reportedly stated that villagers acted out of anger, leading to the incident.

Police have registered a case and assured strict action against those involved. Authorities are also examining the viral video as part of the investigation.

#Chhattisgarh #MobJustice #HumanRights #CrimeNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: Mangalsutra Snatched Outside Party Venue: Ghaziabad Thief Strikes Under Police Watch
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh): A woman was robbed of her mangalsutra by a bike borne criminal near Sanjay Nagar in the Madhuban Bapudham police station area on Thursday night, raising concerns over security in the locality.

body.html:
Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh): A woman was robbed of her mangalsutra by a bike borne criminal near Sanjay Nagar in the Madhuban Bapudham police station area on Thursday night, raising concerns over security in the locality.

The victim, identified as Divya Sharma, wife of Naveen Sharma, was on her way to attend a reception party with family members when the incident occurred on the main road near a farmhouse gate.

According to reports, a helmeted youth arrived on a motorcycle and snatched the mangalsutra from her neck before fleeing the spot. People present at the location attempted to chase the accuse, but he managed to escape.

Police said the accused had allegedly conducted recce in the area prior to the incident. CCTV footage from outside the venue has been examined; however, the suspect’s face and the vehicle’s registration number were not clearly visible.

Officials also noted a discrepancy in the CCTV timestamp, which showed April 18 instead of the actual date of the incident, April 23.

ACP Kavinagar Suryabali Maurya said that no formal complaint had been filed at the time of initial inquiry. Police are working to identify the accuse based on available CCTV footage and local inputs.

Further investigation is underway.

#Ghaziabad #ChainSnatching #Robbery #UPPolice #CCTVFootage

articles.title: Daylight Chain Snatching in Sitamarhi Sparks Outrage, Questions Police Patrolling
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sitamarhi (Bihar): A chain snatching incident in broad daylight at Sitaram Chowk has triggered panic among residents and raised serious concerns over police patrolling in the area. The incident occurred around 8:45 am on Wednesday under the Nagar police station limits.

body.html:
Sitamarhi (Bihar): A chain snatching incident in broad daylight at Sitaram Chowk has triggered panic among residents and raised serious concerns over police patrolling in the area.

The incident occurred around 8:45 am on Wednesday under the Nagar police station limits. According to reports, a woman was walking on the road when two bike borne criminals approached from behind and snatched her gold chain.

The act was carried out swiftly, leaving the victim with no time to react. Despite raising an alarm, the accused managed to flee the spot before locals could intervene.

Following the incident, nearby residents informed the police, who reached the scene and initiated an investigation. Officials said CCTV footage from the area is being examined to identify and track the accused.

SDPO Sadar-1 Rajiv Kumar Singh stated that the suspects have been identified based on CCTV visuals and will be arrested soon. An FIR has been registered in connection with the case.

The incident has sparked anger among local residents, who allege that such crimes are becoming frequent in the city. They questioned the effectiveness of police patrolling, claiming that while patrols are shown on paper, there is minimal police presence on the ground.

Residents have demanded stricter policing and immediate action to curb rising street crimes.

#Sitamarhi #ChainSnatching #BiharNews #CrimeNews #PolicePatrolling
